reason.zh: 官方 evaluator 把两个单值表单字段写成单元素 Alternatives，尚未比较请求就抛错。用正确字段重放后，证据显示 Agent 保存的是 Catalog Price Rule，而合同要求 Cart Price Rule，因此这条历史结果不能改判为通过。
reason.en: The official evaluator encodes two scalar form fields as one-item Alternatives and errors before comparing the request. Re-evaluation with corrected fields shows that the Agent saved a Catalog Price Rule while the contract requires a Cart Price Rule, so the historical result cannot be converted to a pass.
